SHAPE-11 ~100ms BREAKDOWN (nsys, final): mega_eigh_med_split_k reduced-block eigh 38.5ms/42% (THE WALL) | NS-sign+finish+backtransform TF32 GEMMs (s256x256/s128x256/s128x128) ~20ms/20% | CQR batch_trsm_left 9.0ms/9.8% + potrf ~2.9ms | vectorized-add (NS baddbmm + 3xTF32 finish/gate) 5.3ms/5.8% | membership gather/cat/sort ~6ms. NO FP32-SIMT sgemm remaining (was ~5.4ms, moved to TC).

THE 3 WINS: (t2) reduced-block WY back-transform FP32-SIMT->plain TF32 (bt_prec override threaded through _lr_reduced_eigh/_lr_reduced_mega->_mega_med_backtransform, sign-DC-only; shapes 2/3/8/12 keep FP32 via None): shape11 -2.4ms. The finishing 3xTF32 NS+gate absorb TF32's ~3e-4 error -- REFINES brief-22 (TF32 trips the LOW-RANK Rayleigh gate which has no finishing NS, but sign-DC's finishing NS cleans it). (t3) NS-sign iters 20->18: -1.3ms (16 adds NEW fallbacks on 3/5 reseeds, 14 mass-falls-back -> 18 is the SAFE FLOOR). (t4) A^2 power-iter scale estimate 15->4: -2.8ms (eigr FLAT from 3 iters up across 5 seeds -- estimate converges in ~3 iters).

MEASURED NEGATIVES (banked): (t1) tf32x3 back-transform = +13% REGRESSION (Ozaki 3-bmm split tax on the 1280-CTA batch where FP32-SIMT already saturates; matches brief-22). Degree-5 NS sign (15X-10X^3+3X^5)/8 = WORSE than degree-3 at equal GEMM budget (12 iters/36 bmm -> nbad=12 vs degree-3 18-iters nbad=0; near-zero even-spectrum eigenvalues plateau under BOTH, degree-3's gentler-per-iter resolves membership better). CQR passes=1 = mass fallback (640/640, confirms load-bearing). Plain-TF32 finishing NS = mass fallback (orth 0.0095 > 0.0046 gate; finishing NS MUST be 3xTF32). FINAL_NS=2 improves orth 250x (1.1e-5) but does NOT reduce fallback (binding gate is EIGR ~0.0037, not orth).

WHY NO BIGGER WIN: the reduced-block mega_eigh_med_split_k (42%) is the wall -- ncu confirms 66.7% BARRIER-stalled, 50% occ (Block Limit Reg=1 AND SMEM=1), 36% SM, 1.5% DRAM = latency-bound single-CTA SIMT at its ceiling (brief-43 barrier-fixed it; brief-29 panel-WY / brief-50 SBR+cuSOLVER all refuted). It is SHARED with shapes 2/3/8/12 so untouchable at the kernel level here. The CQR trsm (9ms) is refuted to replace (brief-45/48). The binding gate is eigr ~0.0037 (2.5x cushion) which caps how much I can cut NS/BT precision.

OPEN DIRECTIONS (not pursued/reached): (1) the reduced-block kernel is the 42% wall -- a genuinely-batched tensor-core K=300 eigensolver (fill 148 SMs, off the single-CTA SIMT barrier ceiling) would compound across shapes 2/3/8/11/12; brief-50 refuted SBR/cuSOLVER but a DIFFERENT batched primitive (e.g. batched Jacobi on the well-conditioned definite-sign K=300 blocks, or a multi-CTA-per-block cluster kernel at K=300 with DSMEM) is unexplored at K=300. (2) K=300 oversample -> reduced Gram is K=300 but each block has only ~256 real eigenvalues -- a JUNK-FREE variable-rank reduced block (breaks the fixed batched shape) would shrink the kernel; the memory flags this as open. (3) the ~10ms membership gather/cat/sort + ~5ms vectorized-add glue -- fuse the two gathers (membership topk + final sort) or trim 3xTF32 adds if the finishing structure can be reorganized. (4) CUDA-graph the fixed-topology NS-sign+CQR launch sequence (brief-49 refuted explicit-node graphs for the FAST TC kernels since they need capture=banned, but the ~30ms host-dispatch gap on shape 11 remains if capture-framing is ever ruled admissible). Recommend the t2 tf32-back-transform + t3 NS=18 + t4 power=4 stack is a clean disjoint win to combine forward (shape-11-only, no interaction with any other shape's path).
